attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family with the per-TU flags in configure.py

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: When two locals initialize from the SAME constant, write a chained assignment `a = b = CONST;` (one statement per constant pair). The inner variable b then OWNS the pool load (lfs/lfd lands directly in b's home register) and a receives a single fmr from b's home. Writing four separate `= CONST` initializers instead makes MWCC materialize the shared constant in a scratch register and copy it to BOTH homes - one extra fmr per pair, and the scratch web shifts every downstream volatile FPR assignment. In PlayerProcessPowerups this single change collapsed ~600 register-rename diff lines and made the instruction count exact.
